title: Scene frontmatter
description: The prose-to-canon binding: YAML frontmatter at the top of a prose/ch-XX/scene-NN.md file. The scene is the binding unit (conventions.md §10).

contract.description: The scene's stated intent — what it must accomplish, not what happens (conventions.md §10). Every field optional: the contract is clarity, never homework.

purpose.description: What changes because this scene exists

satisfies.description: Narrative obligations this scene discharges (conventions §12) — mat.* ids. Invertible like facts/events: the reports answer which prose meets a requirement.

reader_before.description: What the reader knows or feels going in

reader_after.description: What the reader must know, suspect, or feel afterward

wants.description: What each present character wants in this scene, keyed by char id

constraints.description: POV, historical, or stylistic constraints the prose must respect
